intro: Direction questions describe a walk, a map or a turn. Draw it: put north at the top and east on the right, then follow each step.

tips.title: Draw the compass first
tips.body: Write N at the top, E on the right, S at the bottom and W on the left. Halfway between them are NE, SE, SW and NW.

tips.title: Left and right depend on where you face
tips.body: Facing north, right is east. Facing south, right is west. Facing east, right is south. Turn the page to check if you're unsure.

tips.title: Cancel opposite moves
tips.body: Add up all the north and south moves, then all the east and west moves. Opposite moves cancel each other out.

tips.title: Straight-line distance
tips.body: If you end up a metres east–west and b metres north–south of the start, the distance is √(a² + b²). Look out for 3, 4, 5 and 6, 8, 10.

tips.title: Shadows
tips.body: In the morning the sun is in the east, so shadows point west. In the evening the sun is in the west, so shadows point east.

tips.title: Rotated directions
tips.body: If one direction becomes another, count the steps round the compass (45° each) and turn every direction by the same amount.
